source.description: A slender crimson demoness with obsidian blade forearms and swept-back horns, standing in an elegant fighting stance, blades lowered, tail swaying slowly, hair drifting, violet eyes glowing. Seamless loop.

The crimson demoness with obsidian blade forearms attacks — she spins once gathering momentum, then slashes both curved blades toward the camera in a scissoring cross-cut, then flows back into her elegant stance.

_notes: v3 humanoid character, south direction only. Idle animation stalled twice at 95%% and eventually failed server-side; retried and succeeded. Base sprite approved pre-session; self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
